# Re-directed motion replay appears normal, but Whole Body Tracking training immediately re-terminates and mean episode length stalls at 1, what should be checked first?

> **Current answer:** The original poster's actual issue was that the frame rate and timing parameters were modified, leading to the inability to learn. The conclusion is that the training frame rate must match the prediction frame rate. During diagnosis, align the reference-motion sampling rate, training-environment step rate, and policy inference rate one by one. The thread does not provide specific parameter values or post-fix metrics, so this remains an experience report that must be verified against the target version.
